from collections import deque,defaultdict
def check(G):
    bg=G[0][0]; seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(len(G)) for c in range(len(G[0])) if G[r][c]!=bg]
    cr=sum(r for r,_ in seeds)/len(seeds); cc=sum(c for _,c in seeds)/len(seeds)
    out=[row[:] for row in G]; seen=set()
    for r,c in seeds:
        col=G[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); ch=[]
        while q:
            rr,cc=q.popleft(); ch.append((rr,cc)); seen.add((rr,cc))
            for nr,nc in ((rr-1,cc+1),(rr+1,cc-1)):
                if 0<=nr<len(G) and 0<=nc<len(G[0]) and (nr,nc) not in seen and G[nr][nc]==col:
                    q.append((nr,nc))
        # direction away from center from last added cell? use chain centroid

        dr=int((cr-m[0])*2); dc=int((m[1]-cc)*2)  # away from (cr,cc)

        cur=ch[-1]
        while True:

            if not(0<=nr<len(G) and 0<=nc<len(G[0])) or G[nr][nc]!=bg: break
            out[nr][nc]=col; cur=(nr,nc)

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import deque,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
A,B=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
C,D=E1,E2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
F=G['Test input']

def f(G):
    h,w=len(G),len(G[0]); bg=G[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in G]; done=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if G[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in done:
                col=G[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); ch=[]
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.popleft(); ch.append((rr,cc)); done.add((rr,cc))
                    for nr,nc in ((rr-1,cc+1),(rr+1,cc-1)):
                        if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in done and G[nr][nc]==col:
                            q.append((nr,nc))
                if len(ch)<2: continue
                ch.sort(key=lambda p:p[0])
                L,R=ch[0],ch[-1]
                # main diag or anti? use sign of diagonal step between consecutive cells
                dr=R[0]-L[0]; dc=R[1]-L[1]
                sgn=1 if abs(dr)==abs(dc) else -1
                d=(1,1) if sgn==1 else (1,-1)
                # fill between first and last end cells
                for i in range(L[0],R[0]+1):
                    cc=L[1]+(i-L[0])*dc/dr
                    p=(i,cc)
                    if p!=L and p!=R and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in done and G[p[0]][p[1]]==bg:
                        out[p[0]][p[1]]=col; done.add(p)
                # extend beyond R
                cur=R
                while True:
                    np=(cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1])
                    if not(0<=np[0]<h and 0<=np[1]<w) or np in done or G[np[0]][np[1]]!=bg: break
                    out[np[0]][np[1]]=col; done.add(np); cur=np
                # extend beyond L opposite direction
                od=(-d[0],-d[1])
                cur=L
                while True:
                    np=(cur[0]+od[0],cur[1]+od[1])
                    if not(0<=np[0]<h and 0<=np[1]<w) or np in done or G[np[0]][np[1]]!=bg: break
                    out[np[0]][np[1]]=col; done.add(np); cur=np
    return out
print('demo1:',f(A)==B,'demo2:',f(C)==D)
for name,I,O in [('d1',A,B),('d2',C,D)]:
    R=f(I)
    diff=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c],R[r][c]) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if R[r][c]!=O[r][c]]

from collections import deque
def debugf(G):
    h,w=len(G),len(G[0]); bg=G[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in G]; done=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if G[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in done:
                col=G[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); ch=[]
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.popleft(); ch.append((rr,cc)); done.add((rr,cc))
                    for nr,nc in ((rr-1,cc+1),(rr+1,cc-1)):
                        if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in done and G[nr][nc]==col:
                            q.append((nr,nc))
                if len(ch)<2: continue
                ch.sort(key=lambda p:p[0])
                L,R=ch[0],ch[-1]
                d=(1,1) if R[1]>L[1] else (1,-1)
                # trace fills
                print('comp',sorted(ch),'d',d,'filling')
                cur=(L[0]-1,L[1]-d[1])
                n=0
                while 0<=cur[0]<h and 0<=cur[1]<w and G[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bg and cur not in done:
                    print('  L-out',(n,cur)); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=col; done.add(cur); cur=(cur[0]-1,cur[1]-d[1]); n+=1
                cur=(R[0]+1,R[1]+d[1])
                m=0
                while 0<=cur[0]<h and 0<=cur[1]<w and G[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bg and cur not in done:
                    print('  R-out',(m,cur)); out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=col; done.add(cur); cur=(cur[0]+1,cur[1]+d[1]); m+=1
    return out

import numpy as np,json,os,re
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
